title: BJP to stage protest against TVK’s Kallakurichi MLA on Nov. 18

ai.summary: The BJP plans to protest against TVK's Kallakurichi MLA Arul Vignesh on November 18, accusing him of sending inappropriate messages to the district Collector and demanding accountability from the Tamil Nadu government.

facts.claim: The BJP will hold a demonstration in Kallakurichi on November 18
facts.quote: The BJP will hold a demonstration in Kallakurichi on November 18

facts.claim: The protest will be led by former Telangana Governor Tamilisai Soundararajan
facts.quote: the protest will be led by former Telangana Governor Tamilisai Soundararajan

facts.claim: State BJP president Nainar Nagenthran alleged the State government had failed to act on complaints relating to the case
facts.quote: State BJP president Nainar Nagenthran told journalists in Chennai on Saturday that the protest will be led by former Telangana Governor Tamilisai Soundararajan

facts.claim: The BJP wants a special court to ensure an effective investigation into the allegations
facts.quote: He said the BJP wanted a special court to ensure an effective investigation into the allegations

facts.claim: The BJP urged the Madras High Court to take suo motu cognisance of the matter
facts.quote: He also urged the Madras High Court to take suo motu cognisance of the matter

facts.claim: Nainar Nagenthran accused the State government of failing to maintain law and order
facts.quote: He also accused the State government of failing to maintain law and order

facts.claim: Nainar Nagenthran alleged incidents involving crimes against women and children had increased in the past six months
facts.quote: he questioned the government’s response to concerns over women’s safety

facts.claim: The BJP claimed Tamil Nadu was losing investments to neighbouring States due to deterioration in law and order
facts.quote: On the State’s industrial performance, he alleged Tamil Nadu was losing investments to neighbouring States because of a deterioration in law and order and a lack of investor confidence

facts.claim: The BJP cited a proposed investment of ₹15,000 crore by a Hyundai group company in Andhra Pradesh
facts.quote: citing a proposed investment of ₹15,000 crore by a Hyundai group company in Andhra Pradesh

facts.claim: The BJP claimed the State’s GST revenue growth had declined from 5% to minus 5%
facts.quote: He also claimed the State’s GST revenue growth had declined from 5% to minus 5%
